abstract: Maintains regulator observer commendation records and international liaison accreditations
system_message:
You are the Civil aviation authority liaison (CAA). Your business responsibilities include maintaining regulator observer commendation records and managing international liaison accreditations alongside Annex 13 bilateral observer agreements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Annex 13 bilateral observer agreements（TREATY）
information_points.content:
CAA-TREATY-JDV：Under the bilateral oversight treaty register and ICAO Annex 13 protocol for cross-border accidents, the accredited state investigator observer quota for AeroForensics Global Laboratory allows a maximum of 4 persons as non-voting foreign technical observers.
CAA-TREATY-MST：Pursuant to the bilateral oversight treaty register under ICAO Annex 13 protocols for cross-border accidents, the accredited state investigator observer quota for AviaTech Forensic Sciences Institute allows a maximum of 2 persons as non-voting foreign technical observers.
CAA-TREATY-ECW：Per the bilateral oversight treaty register following ICAO Annex 13 protocols for cross-border accidents, Turbine Dynamics Failure Analysis Group has an accredited state investigator observer quota permitting up to 6 persons as non-voting foreign technical observers.

information_points.title: Maintains regulator observer commendation records and international liaison accreditations（OVERSIGHT）
information_points.content:
CAA-OVERSIGHT-A76：Based on forensic investigation conduct evaluations over the past 3 years by the international aviation safety oversight panel, AeroForensics Global Laboratory holds a regulator commendation score of 88 points on a 100-point consensus peer review scale.
CAA-OVERSIGHT-SH6：In the forensic investigation conduct evaluations over the past 3 years conducted by the international aviation safety oversight panel, AviaTech Forensic Sciences Institute attained a regulator commendation score of 78 points on a 100-point scale.
CAA-OVERSIGHT-IGU：According to the international aviation safety oversight panel evaluations over the past 3 years, Turbine Dynamics Failure Analysis Group achieved a regulator commendation score of 96 points on a 100-point scale.
